description: This header defines the `Notification` class in the Abseil synchronization library, providing thread notification mechanisms with methods for waiting and notifying, using atomic variables and mutexes.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: A class that provides thread notification capabilities, allowing threads to wait for a single event and be notified once.

methods.name: HasBeenNotified
methods.description: Returns whether the notification has been triggered.

methods.name: WaitForNotification
methods.description: Blocks until the notification is triggered.

methods.name: WaitForNotificationWithTimeout
methods.description: Blocks until the notification is triggered or the timeout expires.

methods.name: WaitForNotificationWithDeadline
methods.description: Blocks until the notification is triggered or the deadline passes.

methods.name: Notify
methods.description: Sets the notification as triggered and wakes waiting threads.
